---
name: Feature request
about: Propose a new capability or improvement
labels: enhancement
---

## Summary

Describe the feature in one or two sentences.

## Problem Statement

What problem does this solve? Who is affected?

## Proposed Solution

Describe the expected behavior and preferred implementation approach.

## API and Contract Impact

Does this change any API endpoints, payloads, auth, status codes, or compatibility expectations?

## Operational Impact

Does this affect observability, deployment, performance, security, or runbook procedures?

## Alternatives Considered

List alternatives and why they are less suitable.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] Functional behavior is clearly defined
- [ ] Edge cases are identified
- [ ] Backward compatibility impact is documented
- [ ] Testing approach is described
- [ ] Documentation impact is identified

## Additional Context

Add screenshots, example payloads, links, or related issues.
